items.title: It Wasn’t Time For Jessie To Die, Says Her Husband
items.summary: Although Larry accepts human mortality, he struggles with the sudden death of his wife, nurse Jessie Paya, in the FDS chopper crash. Larry, whose own father passed when he was 10, didn't want their two young children to go through the same thing. items.summary: Malaysian society is gravely ill, unless we discard mutual prejudices, reject the divisive rhetoric of politicians, and commit to advancing together as a resilient and healthy nation. items.title: Galen Centre Launches 2027 Briefing Note For Higher Cigarette Excise Duty
items.summary: The Galen Centre demands a raise in the cigarette excise duty from the current 42 sen per stick to 65 sen under Budget 2027,  followed by scheduled annual increases until 2031. The proposed 2027 increase will add RM4.60 in excise duty for a 20-stick pack. The post Galen Centre Launches 2027 Briefing Note For Higher Cigarette Excise Duty appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: My Children Keep Me Going, Says Alexson’s Widow
items.summary: Alexson's widow, Stephanie, says she felt like she lost half of her soul when her husband died in the Long Lellang tragedy. But her two young children give her the strength to continue. She misses ordinary routines, like Alexson asking her, "What to eat?" The post My Children Keep Me Going, Says Alexson’s Widow appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: The real question is not whether Malaysia is ready for a sustainable health financing model, but whether we can afford to spend another decade pretending we have another choice. items.title: MPs Demand Additional Compensation For FDS Crash Families Beyond Ex-Gratia
items.summary: Bandar Kuching MP Kelvin Yii and Stampin MP Chong Chieng Jen want substantial compensation for families of the five victims in the Long Lellang crash. Yii says the compensation must be on top of ex-gratia payments. Chong says it should be at least RM100k. The post MPs Demand Additional Compensation For FDS Crash Families Beyond Ex-Gratia appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Third FDS Crash Family Slams MOH’s Absent Support
items.summary: After complaints from two Miri families, a third victim's family in the FDS chopper crash, pilot Captain Zainol Afiq's widow, has denounced MOH's silence and lack of support, saying Layang Layang Aerospace "paid for everything". She has two young children. The post Third FDS Crash Family Slams MOH’s Absent Support appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: Malaysia must shift its health care financing model from short-term hospitalisation coverage to sustainable, shared-responsibility frameworks that support long-term chronic care. The post When Illness Lasts A Lifetime: Rethinking How Malaysia Finances Chronic Care — Dr K. Thiruchelvam appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: PMX, Step In For The Sake Of Public Health Care — Dr Timothy Cheng
items.summary: PM Anwar, if doctors are rejecting permanent positions that were once used as a carrot to entice them, it’s obvious that the system has failed. JPA, MOF, and MOH must come up with real decisions before public health care slides further towards collapse. The post PMX, Step In For The Sake Of Public Health Care — Dr Timothy Cheng appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MOH Should Have Done More, Say Two FDS Crash Families
items.summary: The families of MA Alexson and nurse Jessie, who were killed in the FDS chopper crash, say MOH gave them little immediate support, as funeral costs were borne by Layang Layang Aerospace instead. They want additional compensation beyond ex-gratia payments. The post MOH Should Have Done More, Say Two FDS Crash Families appeared first on CodeBlue .
